text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Her race against Taiki in the Yasuda
Kinen was such a pleasure to watch! It's
hard not getting
blown away by her
explosive power!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan B
text_block_list.text:
For sure. She really uses her size to her 
advantage. The way she sped up while
rounding
the last corner is
unforgettable!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her run always puts me in a
better mood and gives me the energy to
get through another
day. I'm glad I saw
her race!

text_block_list.name: Bono Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Today'll be a great one too. Just
you wait
and see!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... It's so nice to be praised.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I got AAALL my ducks lined up for our
fight
today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm goin' home the winner today! I hope
you're
ready!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I sure am! Ehehe! I'm gonna do my best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks for letting me have my way,
Trainer.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(You probably knew from the start what
the
better path for me was, but you still
let me do
this.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
(I'll get a real good look at everyone's
reactions
today. Then, I'll know for sure
what to do!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! Time to do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curtain rises on the Sprinters S. as
excitement
amps up throughout the
stands.
